<function name="HasEnemyEluded" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Polls the enemy memory to check if the given entity has eluded us or not.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2020.06.24</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="enemy" type="Entity" default="GetEnemy()">The enemy to test.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="eluded" type="boolean">If the enemy has eluded us.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
